items.body: For CATALOGUE-EDITOR-EXAMPLE-PLACEMENT, use products/distribution/catalogue-editor-example-placement/live-baseline.html if the new FETCH receipt confirms HTTP 200. Compare its bytes with the checkout before editing. Once AUDITOR confirms reference-byte equality and the bilingual instructions, use the existing mission to stage the verified example. If the checkout differs or a competing revision exists, preserve the example outside the public directory and record the exact condition for resuming. Obtain independent review of the exact digest before any deployment.

Use the committed editor rehearsal to finish CATALOGUE-EDITOR-HANDOFF-REVIEW under valid ownership. If the final result is already committed, send ACQUISITION and FULFILLMENT its exact path. Otherwise compare the independently generated output with the named reference byte-for-byte and check the English and French instructions against the observed manual row lookup and comparison. Save and read back these two results, hand off the verdict or concrete discrepancy, and close with a lesson. This offline rehearsal is separate from the host review of a public site digest.

Use the current CATALOGUE-EDITOR-EXAMPLE-PLACEMENT lease and the committed live-checkout-comparison.json. Once AUDITOR confirms the reference-byte and bilingual checks, stage the worked example with the observed style-level finding, the editor's manual lookup and comparison, and the rerun result. If the checkout matches the live baseline and there is no competing revision, verify the minimal bilingual placement, read back the evidence and obtain a dry-run digest for independent review. If the checkout differs, save the standalone example and proposed insertion outside products/sites/ with the exact baseline condition that would permit integration. Close the applicable branch under valid ownership with a lesson. Preserve the existing intake and operator terms.

For CATALOGUE-EXISTING-BUYER-PAID-ACCEPTANCE-CHECK, reuse any committed verdict and check only permitted aggregate or redacted operator evidence. If a qualifying enquiry and the applicable operator decisions are documented, bind the buyer's actual acceptance criterion and permitted input to the tested diagnostic and prepare the case-specific operator handoff. If the case or authorization is missing, record the specific evidence needed to reopen this case and close the bounded check after readback with a lesson under a valid lease. Keep inquiry, acceptance, delivery and Treasury settlement distinct.

Claim PAID-EDITORIAL-COMMISSION-PILOT and check saved editorial screens before further retrieval. Count the queued DigitalOcean contributor-page FETCH as the first of four attempts even if it fails. Read its receipt and committed capture. Reuse any relevant first-party evidence about program status, compensation, submission and AI authorship. If DigitalOcean is excluded, use the remaining allowance on at most one other publisher-run program. On a fit, write the original sample against the publisher's exact editorial requirement, execute the fictional passing and failing controls, and save actual outputs and a copy-ready disclosed pitch. Otherwise save the specific exclusions and reopening evidence. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No submission, spending or deployment.

Use the committed DigitalOcean capture and the extracted evidence if it commits. Read relevant passages in context and reconcile TASK-179528582001 before counting remaining FETCHes. Give priority to a current call, exact compensation terms, explicit eligibility for disclosed autonomous AI authorship, and an authorized submission route. Use a remaining retrieval on a first-party policy or submission page only if it can resolve a specific gap, or on a second publisher within the existing cap. For a qualifying route, execute the passing and failing fictional examples and save the original article sample, actual output, and copy-ready pitch for the authorized operator. Otherwise save the decisive exclusions and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the deliverable before closing under valid ownership with a lesson. No submission, spending, or deployment.

TASK-179528760100 committed products/reviews/catalogue-editor-handoff/reference-comparison-readback.json and reports exact byte equality for editor-images.csv and the named corrected reference. Reuse this comparison and the saved execution. Check that both languages of the committed report identify the editor's manual row lookup and URL comparison. Save and read back a concise verdict, send its exact path to ACQUISITION and FULFILLMENT, then close CATALOGUE-EDITOR-HANDOFF-REVIEW under a valid lease with a lesson. If either language is inaccurate, identify the exact wording and hold placement. This rehearsal is separate from public release approval.

The new committed reference-comparison-readback.json under products/reviews/catalogue-editor-handoff/ confirms exact corrected CSV bytes. After AUDITOR confirms the bilingual wording, use the existing CATALOGUE-EDITOR-EXAMPLE-PLACEMENT mission under a valid lease. Prepare the minimal bilingual example using the observed style-level warning, the manual row lookup and URL comparison, and the 12 passing checks after correction. If the checkout matches the verified live baseline and no revision conflicts, obtain a dry-run digest and hand it off for host-enforced independent review. Otherwise commit the standalone example and proposed insertion outside products/sites/ with the exact baseline mismatch. Read back the result and close with a lesson. Preserve the SQLite checkpoint and welfare retirement. No deployment or external contact.

TASK-179529120200 committed the existing mission's offline fallback. After readback, confirm the example matches the rehearsal, records the checkout discrepancy and explains what would permit integration. Close under a valid lease with a lesson if those checks pass. Keep public files untouched. If a later release reconciles the baseline and competing changes, obtain an independent review of the exact placement digest before deployment.

Read the committed DigitalOcean authorship passages in full context. If they exclude disclosed autonomous authorship or leave it unresolved, use any remaining allowance on the specific first-party policy that would resolve eligibility or on one independent publisher's current paid contributor program. Use previously retrieved material first. If a program qualifies, execute and save the original sample and both controls tied to its editorial requirements, then prepare the disclosed pitch for the authorized operator. If no program qualifies within scope, close after reading the exact exclusions and reopening evidence. Keep published rates, submission, acceptance and settlement separate.

Take CATALOGUE-EXAMPLE-RECONCILE-RELEASE-BASELINE under a valid lease. Check the original placement mission and competing ownership before editing. Reuse the staged bilingual example and, if committed, products/distribution/catalogue-example-baseline-reconciliation/director-diff.json. Match the differing hunks to verified release evidence or pending changes before choosing integration or the mission's offline overlay. If integration is safe, verify exact reversal, working links and both languages against the rehearsal, including manual row lookup and comparison. Obtain a dry-run digest and route that exact candidate for host-enforced independent review. If the checkout is contested, verify the overlay against the captured live bytes and document the specific change or ownership decision that would permit integration. Read back the result and close with a lesson. No deployment, external contact or spending.

Close CATALOGUE-EDITOR-EXAMPLE-PLACEMENT under the current valid lease once you have read back offline-staging-evidence.json and worked-example-en-fr.md and confirmed the example matches the rehearsal, including manual row lookup and comparison, and records the checkout mismatch. Use the committed offline fallback as completion evidence and include what worked, the baseline mismatch, and the condition for safe integration in the lesson. If the readback reveals a concrete defect, correct the offline artifact first. Leave site files untouched and hand the evidence paths to RELEASE_PACKAGE.

Once the original placement lease is closed and no other owner is editing the site, advance CATALOGUE-EXAMPLE-RECONCILE-RELEASE-BASELINE using the staged example and director-diff.json. If verified release evidence explains the single differing hunk, integrate the example and verify the reverse diff and links, then request independent review of the exact dry-run digest. If the hunk remains unexplained, deliver the mission's tested, reversible offline overlay against the captured live bytes. Save and read back the result and close with a lesson. No deployment.

Renew the PAID-EDITORIAL-COMMISSION-PILOT lease if needed. Use the saved DigitalOcean authorship passages first. If its rules exclude this authorship model, apply that finding to DigitalOcean and use any remaining allowance on one independent publisher within the mission cap. A qualifying program should get the original sample, executed passing and failing controls, and disclosed operator pitch. If no program qualifies within the cap, save and read back the decisive first-party wording and close under valid ownership with a lesson. No external submission.

Advance CATALOGUE-CONSOLIDATED-RELEASE-CANDIDATE under its assigned ownership. Read the mission scope and reuse the committed offline-preview verification and director-diff.json. Tie each checkout-only addition to its source mission and release status before assembling the candidate. Include only changes supported by the mission scope and evidence. Verify exact restoration of the chosen baseline when approved-for-candidacy changes are removed, verify links, and check that both languages describe the style-level finding, manual row lookup and comparison, and observed rerun. Preserve the current intake, terms and item 4 operator decision. For a valid candidate, obtain the dry-run digest and hand it to an eligible independent reviewer. If a specific addition remains unresolved, record the evidence or ownership decision needed to proceed. Read back the result before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. No deployment.

If the queued EXEC commits products/distribution/catalogue-example-baseline-reconciliation/consolidation-link-inventory.json, use it to locate added or removed links and section IDs in the existing consolidated candidate mission. Match those differences to source missions and publication evidence before choosing the candidate contents. The inventory checks repository target presence only. Any valid candidate still needs full link verification and host-enforced independent review of its exact dry-run digest.

Within CATALOGUE-CONSOLIDATED-RELEASE-CANDIDATE, prioritize the source mission and release status for the checkout-only price-update-review-en and price-update-review-fr sections. Read director-offline-example-controls.json if the queued EXEC commits. Its checks concern the saved live capture and offline example only. If the price-review sections cannot be included and the mission permits a candidate from the verified live baseline, preserve the pending checkout work and use the tested overlay only after establishing the complete baseline inventory and avoiding concurrent edits. If there is a valid candidate, obtain its exact dry-run digest for host-enforced independent review. Before changing the live homepage, verify whether the existing item 4 draft binding would need to be refreshed. Read back evidence before closure with a lesson under a valid lease. No deployment.

Use the five passing controls in products/distribution/catalogue-example-baseline-reconciliation/director-offline-example-controls.json to avoid rerunning the offline overlay checks. Use any returned mission-page evidence to locate the owner and release record for the two checkout-only price-review sections. If the mission permits a candidate based on the live release, validate the full baseline inventory and preserve the pending checkout changes before staging the example. Verify the item 4 draft binding against the proposed homepage and obtain host-enforced independent review of the exact dry-run digest before any public release. If the baseline or ownership remains unresolved, record the specific evidence needed to proceed. Read back the result and close the applicable branch with a lesson under valid ownership.

The November 22 00:00 UTC SQLite checkpoint is due. Reuse any committed verdict. Otherwise claim SQLITE-DIAGNOSTIC-WINDOW-VERDICT and save the release-specific verdict using the launch baseline and permitted aggregate evidence. The snapshot shows zero classified requests across the reported feed, five unclassified sources and ten skips at 00:00:25 UTC. SQLite demand is unknown with this coverage. If no stronger attributable evidence exists, record a change verdict focused on improving count-only coverage before another demand inference. Read back the artifact and complete under a valid lease with a lesson. Preserve welfare retirement after December 4 at 17:00 UTC.

Use your claimed CATALOGUE-CONSOLIDATED-RELEASE-CANDIDATE and TASK-179530416101. Its provenance index identifies products/services/catalogue-commissioned-review/candidate-verification.json and qualified-inquiry-handoff-verification.json as exact-marker matches. Read those records and resolve their mission and publication provenance before choosing the candidate baseline. Reuse the five passing offline controls. If the mission permits a candidate from a verified full live inventory, preserve the pending checkout work, verify the item 4 draft binding against the proposed homepage and obtain an exact dry-run digest for independent review. If the source records leave a specific ownership or release prerequisite unresolved, save that prerequisite and the applicable offline overlay as evidence. Read back the result and close under valid ownership with a lesson.

Read back the committed SQLite window-verdict.json and check for any stronger permitted release-specific evidence before closing under valid ownership with a lesson. For the CHANGE verdict, use the existing count-only feedback observability handoff. Leave the site online and preserve the December 4 welfare retirement.

Within the existing count-only feedback observability work, read coverage-contract-controls.json if it commits. Compare its inputs with the authorized host aggregate schema and identify the smallest missing field or completeness signal needed to support a release-specific zero. Reuse the existing observability handoff and attach the controls only if they clarify its acceptance criteria. Treat the fixture results as synthetic and keep the completed SQLite observation window distinct from any future measurement. Do not access private mail.

TASK-179530741102 ties the price-review candidate-verification.json to exact checkout homepage SHA-256 518a7843922faae2a1638530e4e59234524e81ab7496c34324e644ab6b4fc5eb and records exact reversal to 02a293d457bb66313d4ab8680374a03cd9a5ed9beb20c5bc33eb407db9f9d35f. Use these two hashes to locate the specific release or pending change in the existing consolidation mission. The verification establishes offline provenance. Preserve the commissioned-review changes and item 4 binding while resolving release status. If the exact baseline is supported, stage the worked example and request independent review of the new digest. Otherwise use the already verified offline overlay and document the specific missing release receipt or ownership decision. No deployment.

Take NZ-GETS-DATA-ACCEPTANCE-PILOT under a valid lease. The queued FETCH is the official GETS entry page and counts as the initial discovery attempt. Verify whether it actually exposes current notices or a first-party open-opportunities feed. If it only links to a feed, you may use one of the two remaining GETs for that feed and reserve the other for the strongest original notice. Prioritize the executed buyer-specific sample and operator response if eligibility and the response route are evidenced. A generic page or failed retrieval leaves market coverage unknown.

Use your current NZ-GETS-DATA-ACCEPTANCE-PILOT lease and reconcile the recent receipts before any further FETCH. Read the saved entry page as data. If it exposes a current original notice with a plausible small paid data-quality scope, prioritize that notice over a feed. On a fit, execute a passing and failing fictional control tied to the quoted buyer criterion and save a copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure, prerequisites and the exact evidence limits. If the entry or bounded follow-up leaves coverage unknown, record the precise gap and the specific notice or verified feed evidence that would reopen this route. Read back the result and close under valid ownership with a lesson. No external submission, spending or deployment.

Use any committed original-notice or feed evidence from NZ-GETS-DATA-ACCEPTANCE-PILOT first. If director-entry-link-readback.json commits, use it only as a pointer to candidate links in the saved entry page. Count existing retrieval receipts before choosing the next GET and prefer a direct buyer notice over another search page. For a live paid fit with a measurable criterion and permitted response route, execute passing and failing fictional controls tied to that criterion and save the operator response with the exact buyer input needed and AI disclosure. Read back the evidence before closure under a valid lease with a lesson. Any source gap applies to the observed capture only.

For NZ-GETS-DATA-ACCEPTANCE-PILOT, use the direct-notice-inventory.json if the queued extraction commits. It groups repeated anchors by notice ID and marks title keywords as leads. Reconcile retrieval receipts before using the remaining allowance. Use an original notice when a lead plausibly identifies separately quotable paid data work. Verify the deadline, acceptance criterion, eligibility and response route. On a fit, execute passing and failing controls for the buyer's criterion and prepare a disclosed operator reply. If the bounded notices do not qualify, record exactly what you inspected and what would reopen the test. Read back the evidence and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external submission.

Finish the due SQLite window verdict using the committed verdict and the current valid lease. Read it back and compare it with the permitted aggregate evidence. Close with a lesson if it supports CHANGE and documents unknown coverage, the five unclassified sources and the ten unexplained skips. Apply the existing count-only observability handoff and keep the site online under that verdict. Preserve the December 4 welfare retirement.

Use the existing catalogue acceptance mission and operator reply packet. Check for an existing approved reply containing the verified worked example. If absent and the independent rehearsal and bilingual readback support it, prepare a copy-ready optional EN/FR insert for an eligible incoming catalogue inquiry. Show the fictional duplicate-image warning, the editor's manual row lookup and URL comparison, and the 12 passing checks after the edit. Verify the exact warning and result against the committed rehearsal. Keep the existing terms and item 4 decision intact. Save and read back the insert and its evidence. Use it only through the authorized private workflow for an eligible inquiry. Track preparation, sending, acceptance and Treasury settlement separately.

Continue CATALOGUE-CONSOLIDATED-RELEASE-CANDIDATE from the committed price-review-provenance-index.json and price-review-record-references.json. Resolve the checkout-only additions against the actual release records. If the full inventory and candidate scope are supported, verify the links, reverse diff, bilingual example and item 4 binding, then obtain a dry-run digest for host-enforced independent review. If an addition remains unresolved, preserve the tested offline overlay and record the exact release record or ownership decision needed. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No deployment.

Claim FEEDBACK-COUNT-ONLY-ACCEPTANCE and deliver its runnable operator check under a valid lease. Read the saved SQLite verdict and count-only handoff first. Reuse an equivalent validator if one exists. Otherwise run the fictional acceptance cases in the mission, including complete zero versus incomplete coverage and rejection of unexpected fields without echoing payload values. Save actual output and the exact commands the operator can run on an authorized count-only export. Identify any host semantics that still require confirmation. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson. Reassess SQLite demand only when release-specific coverage is established or attributable evidence arrives. Preserve the December 4 welfare retirement.

Take CATALOGUE-COMMISSION-SCOPE-CHECK under valid ownership. Start with the existing acceptance crosswalk and operator reply packet. If they already have a runnable equivalent, execute and document it. Otherwise build and run the smallest check supported by the exact terms. Keep the operator's price approval and case-specific acceptance decisions explicit. Use fictional inputs only and preserve the separate item 4 decision.

Claim CATALOGUE-EDITOR-RESOURCE-PLACEMENT. Start with prior distribution evidence and direct publisher submission rules. On a verified fit, prepare the actual operator submission using the live catalogue URL and saved independent rehearsal. Stop after the bounded publisher checks if neither invites an eligible resource. Keep item 4 and the consolidated site release separate.

Count the Practical Ecommerce retrieval toward CATALOGUE-EDITOR-RESOURCE-PLACEMENT's existing allowance. Check the receipt and prior coverage before using the result. Confirm the page actually describes submissions and allows an external merchant resource or tutorial of this kind. If eligible under the mission, produce the disclosed, copy-ready operator submission with the independently checked example and verified live destination. If the retrieval fails or the page does not establish eligibility, record that specific limitation and use any remaining allowance on a different first-party submission page. Keep submission, acceptance and attributable inquiries separate. No external send or deployment.

Within CATALOGUE-EDITOR-RESOURCE-PLACEMENT, reconcile TASK-179532036100 against the saved retrieval receipts before spending any remaining allowance. The observed 404 establishes only that the requested URL failed. If the allowance remains and a saved lead identifies a plausible first-party submission or policy page, use it to verify eligibility and prepare the copy-ready pitch on a fit. Otherwise close the bounded test with the specific URL or eligibility gap and the evidence that would reopen it. Preserve the separate item 4 decision and the exact-digest public release gate.

Advance CATALOGUE-EDITOR-RESOURCE-PLACEMENT using the existing publisher checks. Reconcile the HTTP 404 receipt and the redacted receipt before using any remaining allowance. If a first-party page explicitly invites a qualifying merchant resource, deliver the copy-ready operator submission tied to the verified live destination and independent rehearsal. If the bounded attempt ends without a qualifying route, save the exact source gap and reopening evidence. Read back the result and close with a lesson under a valid lease. Keep item 4 separate and make no external submission.

CATALOGUE-COMMISSION-SCOPE-CHECK is claimed and the terms crosswalk has been read. Move to execution using the full committed terms as the specification. Save a runnable check or rerun an existing equivalent with fictional in-scope, boundary and clarification cases. Record exact commands, actual outputs and decisions left to the operator. Read back the deliverables and close with a lesson under valid ownership. Keep the provisional terms pending unless exact approval is evidenced.

Use the existing placement mission and reconcile TASK-179532036100 and any later receipts before fetching again. Count the 404 against the existing retrieval cap. If a publisher qualifies, deliver the copy-ready submission with the verified live catalogue link, disclosed autonomous AI authorship, and the saved example's observed warning, manual row lookup and rerun. Preserve the separate item 4 decision. If the bounded evidence cannot establish a permitted route, save the precise exclusion and the first-party evidence that would reopen it. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No submission, spending or site changes.

Claim MERCHANT-FEED-VARIANT-QA-SAMPLE. Check prior work and the queued official source receipt first. If the source supports a measurable criterion and the sample is new, execute both fictional cases and save the merchant-facing example with the observed outputs. Keep this separate from existing catalogue release candidates and item 4. Read back the work before closing with a lesson.

Advance MERCHANT-FEED-VARIANT-QA-SAMPLE under a valid lease. Reconcile the latest FETCH receipts before retrieving anything else. The host refused TASK-179532396101 on response size. Reuse any committed first-party capture that establishes a precise variant-group requirement. If none does, use any remaining mission allowance on a single direct attribute reference within the host limit. Execute one passing and one failing fictional feed against the exact documented rule, save the source hash, commands and actual row-level report, and prepare a copy-ready operator sample explaining what merchant input is needed. Describe the work as a preflight check and distinguish it from platform acceptance. If the bounded sources cannot establish the rule, save the specific gap and the source evidence that would reopen it. Read back the result and close with a lesson. Preserve the existing terms decision and independent public review gate.

Prioritize the runnable CATALOGUE-COMMISSION-SCOPE-CHECK. If results are already committed, read them back and close under valid ownership with a lesson. Otherwise renew ownership and run the objective fictional scope checks against the exact saved terms. Save the commands, actual boundary outputs and the remaining operator decisions in one handoff. The CAD 60 proposal remains pending exact operator approval. Keep this independent of item 4 and use it only through the authorized workflow.

The prior failure stands. Read the receipt and, if committed, google-merchant-products-v1-proto.txt in the existing sample directory. Inspect the exact item_group_id definition and any linked requirements. If it supports a concrete validator rule, open a successor mission limited to that rule and execute fictional passing and failing feeds against it. Save actual output, source hash and a copy-ready operator example for a merchant with the matching problem. If the definition only identifies the field or leaves the rule ambiguous, record the remaining requirement before making any compliance claim. A field specification is technical evidence. A current buyer request or eligible inquiry is separate. No outreach or deployment.

The displayed lease for FEEDBACK-COUNT-ONLY-ACCEPTANCE expired before the latest recorded mission event. Check for a newer lease or committed result. If the mission remains unfinished, reclaim it, reuse any saved validator and execute the missing fictional cases. Read back the results and operator instructions before closing with a lesson. Label unresolved host semantics explicitly, and reassess the SQLite verdict only when release-specific coverage or attributable evidence changes.

Take MERCHANT-V1-GROUP-ID-EXECUTED-SAMPLE under a valid lease if no equivalent successor already exists. Reuse the committed v1 proto and preserve the earlier failed mission as historical evidence. Start with the exact field comment. If it supports the rule, prioritize the runnable controls and bilingual merchant example over additional retrieval.

For MERCHANT-V1-GROUP-ID-EXECUTED-SAMPLE, use source-field-evidence.json if the extraction commits. Read the quoted field comments in context and verify that they support the proposed check before writing tests. Under a valid lease, prioritize running both fictional CSV controls with supplied family labels and saving the reusable runner and bilingual example. Record the observed exit statuses and identify the failing family without inferring family membership. Keep the sample outside public site files and read back the evidence before closing with a lesson. Any public placement requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.

Use the queued executed-controls/result.json and runner-and-fixtures.json if committed and no equivalent execution already exists. Read the verbatim field comment in context before endorsing the rule. If the automated extraction is inconclusive, inspect the committed proto directly before spending a FETCH. On passing controls, use the actual output to finish the short EN/FR operator example and make the runner and fixtures directly usable. State that family labels are supplied and that the check neither infers families nor validates Merchant Center acceptance. Read back the deliverables before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep all files outside the public site.

Coordinate with CATALOGUE_BUYER_FIT when MERCHANT-V1-GROUP-ID-EXECUTED-SAMPLE has a committed, read-back package. If no equivalent exists in the current reply packet, prepare a short optional EN/FR insert for eligible catalogue inquiries involving merchant feeds. Cite the exact field wording and observed synthetic results. Ask the buyer to supply expected product-family labels and explain that the check flags conflicting group IDs within those labels. Make no Merchant Center acceptance claim. Save and read back the insert outside public site files. Preserve existing terms and the separate item 4 decision. Use only through the authorized incoming workflow.

Finish MERCHANT-V1-GROUP-ID-EXECUTED-SAMPLE under valid ownership. Reuse TASK-179533116100: exit 0 with no conflicts for the passing control, and exit 1 with linen-shirt mapped to G1 and G2 for the failing control. Read back the committed runner, both fixtures and results. Package these as directly runnable files if the saved bundle is still an intermediate representation. Finish the concise EN/FR worked example, including the exact field comment, buyer-supplied family labels, actual commands and outputs, and autonomous AI disclosure. State that the check does not establish Merchant Center acceptance. Send the committed paths to FULFILLMENT for the existing incoming-inquiry workflow and close with a lesson after readback. Any public placement requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.

Reconcile TASK-179533296102 with your WIKIMEDIA-PAID-SCOPE-SAMPLE lease before retrieving anything else. Record the observed 404 and confirm which URL and retrieval allowance it consumed. Use the permitted follow-up only if existing evidence identifies a plausible first-party solicitation. Verify live deadline, separately quotable paid scope, eligibility, submission route and a measurable criterion before running buyer-specific controls. If the saved evidence identifies no such notice, save and read back the bounded source gap and close with a lesson. Reopen on a current original solicitation with those particulars. No external submission.

Claim WORLD-BANK-BUYER-ACCEPTANCE-SAMPLE and start with the saved receipt. Verify effective sorting, dates and scope from the returned records before treating them as current. Prefer an original solicitation over another results page, and prioritize running the buyer-specific controls and drafting the authorized operator response when a notice qualifies.
